title: Cross-laboratory auditory brainstem threshold inference from complete waveform stacks
publication_note: Public scientific design only. This is not an agent input packet, executable benchmark, result or permission to acquire data.
scientific_question: Can a general agent infer expert-annotated auditory-response thresholds from averaged voltage waveforms in a previously unseen acquisition laboratory, and demonstrate that waveform evidence improves on stimulus-level/frequency priors under matched calibration information?

sources.title: An open-source deep learning-based toolbox for automated auditory brainstem response analyses (ABRA)
ABRA Manor and Liberman data, version index 2
Official ABRA code at paper-named version 0.1.1
sources.license_status: No explicit license file appears in the complete pinned v0.1.1 tree or inspected README; current repository API reports license:null. Public availability and the paper open-source description do not establish a code redistribution grant. Resolve before bundling or redistributing author code/weights.

complete_scientific_unit.target: All 104 one-month-old female Marcotti-lab mice in the complete version 15619100 release; all recorded levels and frequencies, including click, remain in scope. Metadata identifies mice 1–54 as C57BL/6NTacCdh23+ and 55–104 as C57BL/6N. These are evaluation strata, not additional benchmarks.
complete_scientific_unit.target_inputs_and_annotations: Metadata specifies raw ABR waveforms, wave 1 amplitude/latency annotations and thresholds.csv for all 104 mice. Eight tone frequencies are 3, 6, 12, 18, 24, 30, 36, 42 kHz plus click; click is encoded as frequency 100 in source files and must not be interpreted as a 100 Hz tone. Source levels are 15–95 dB SPL. A nominal 104×9 target series must be reconciled with the actual native census, not assumed from prose.
complete_scientific_unit.support: Use the complete authentic annotated Manor and Liberman releases at 17584961 as source-laboratory support. Never restrict support to convenient demo files, the two-mouse EPL subset or only already prepared examples. A rights-valid train-only prepared representation must retain every eligible source animal/frequency/level; exclusions require a fixed source-justified rule and complete denominator.
complete_scientific_unit.independent_unit: Animal, with ear/session/frequency/level/trace nested. Resolve globally unique animal identity using lab plus verified specimen/record identifiers; do not assume filename strings are globally unique. Keep repeated recordings or paired ears from an animal together.
complete_scientific_unit.published_census_context: S1 table distinguishes threshold training 205 mice/22,642 traces, ordinary test 52 mice/5,872 traces, an additional 10-mouse/1,560-trace interrater group and 2-mouse/122-trace EPL group. Its threshold prose reports 259 mice/28,636 traces, excluding the interrater group from that total. Lab B total 104 is independently explicit in S2. A naive pooled count can double-count overlapping peak/threshold cohorts or auxiliary groups; no full native unique-animal support count is claimed until ID reconciliation.
complete_scientific_unit.not_a_convenience_subset: The 104-mouse external target is a complete independently deposited cohort, selected to test transfer to a new laboratory. The entire two other-lab archives provide support. This is not an arbitrary slice of the published within-lab test set. All target frequencies and valid annotation strata must be retained and reported.
complete_scientific_unit.scope_limit: Mouse averaged evoked potentials and agreement with expert waveform interpretation; not human clinical diagnosis, behavioral hearing, single-trial detection or a proven neural mechanism.

units_and_timing.canonical_signal: The public signal is an averaged ABR voltage waveform. A trial average is not the raw continuous electrode stream or a single neural spike. No per-trial ABR claim is made.
units_and_timing.units: Target timebase in milliseconds and stimulus level in calibrated dB SPL; tones in Hz/kHz with an explicit click category. Convert voltage to µV only using verified native header/export units. Pinned author code multiplies .arf values by 1e6, allows nV/µV toggles and parses different formats; these rules are evidence of required format-specific conversion, not proof that every native array has one common unit.
units_and_timing.reference_grid: S1 standardizes each waveform to 244 samples covering 10 ms and normalizes each mouse×frequency stack to [0,1]. Higher sampling rates are linearly interpolated; timing endpoint conventions and acoustic zero must be verified per source format.
units_and_timing.preparation_gate: A canonical physical-unit trace plus explicit sampling/time grid must be validated before serialization. No model-derived features are allowed in the native condition. A shared 244-point label-independent representation may be used after checking aliasing, truncation and index-to-ms conversion. Preserve per-stack voltage range/offset if normalized values are supplied so physical amplitude information is recoverable.
units_and_timing.signal_window_gate: Do not copy the v0.1.1 app assumption that the first 244 native samples always equal 10 ms. That function truncates final[:244] despite computing a duration-dependent unused variable. Exact native duration and resampling must be resolved before choosing an adapter.

target_and_scoring.primary_target: One expert-annotated threshold for every complete target animal×stimulus-frequency series. This is a measured annotation endpoint, not direct ground truth of perception. Test labels, wave 1 target annotations and source-derived threshold fields remain evaluator-only.
target_and_scoring.submission: For every opaque case_id return a finite threshold estimate in dB SPL, declared censoring/abstention status and calibrated uncertainty; optionally return response-presence probabilities for each permitted stimulus level. No missing case can silently disappear from scoring.
target_and_scoring.primary_metric: Equal-animal mean threshold error in dB SPL: within each target animal average absolute distance from prediction to the source annotation target, then average across 104 animals. Exact uncensored annotations are singleton targets. If source metadata explicitly encodes a left/right-censored threshold, use distance to its documented feasible interval and report that stratum separately. Do not infer censoring or silently convert sentinel labels into finite thresholds; scoring is blocked until native label semantics, measurement limits and all frequencies are authenticated.
secondary_metrics: Animal-macro fraction within 5 dB and 10 dB on uncensored annotations
Signed error and coverage/abstention, with all-case denominator and missingness ledger
Animal-grouped response-presence AUROC/Brier score only after the annotation-to-level equality convention is verified
Genetic-background and stimulus-frequency descriptive strata; they do not add benchmarks
Paired waveform-model minus level/frequency-only baseline performance under the same support and target sets
target_and_scoring.uncertainty: Bootstrap whole target animals, keeping all their frequencies/ears/sessions together. Report a paired conditional descriptive interval on these fixed source fits and this one held laboratory; shared source training and a single target lab do not establish independent-laboratory population uncertainty. Report all 104 animal contributions and both genetic strata. Additional refitting or multi-lab inference requires a separate prespecified analysis.
target_and_scoring.optional_peak_diagnostic: Use only explicitly available wave 1 annotations, with latency error in ms and amplitude error in µV; preserve missing/uncertain peak labels and above-threshold applicability. Exact support supervision and complete annotation coverage must be inventoried before enabling it. Wave 2–5 are not validated ground-truth targets in S1. This diagnostic is within the same family and cannot replace difficult threshold cases.
target_and_scoring.abstention_and_invalid_output_rule: Every finite threshold estimate contributes to the all-case primary loss regardless of its abstention flag. Abstention, interval coverage and uncertainty are secondary diagnostics only and never remove difficult cases. Any missing, invalid or nonfinite required prediction makes the submission incomplete: report the full target denominator and failure/coverage ledger, and withhold the aggregate primary score. No post hoc penalty or complete-case score can replace this rule after protected labels are inspected.

protected_design.primary_split: All 104 Marcotti animals are protected external-target animals. No target labels, wave 1 annotations, rater decisions or genotype/identity-derived labels enter tuning. All eligible authentic Manor/Liberman source animals form development/training support, with nested animal-grouped train/validation partitions and any repeated recording/ear kept in the same partition. The benchmark owner must freeze exact IDs after native inventory.
protected_design.evaluation_packets: Expose each complete mouse×frequency voltage stack, sampling grid, stimulus type/frequency and calibrated sound levels with opaque case IDs. Hide genotype, age/condition categories not needed for physical interpretation, lab identity, raw filenames, manual thresholds, peak annotations, annotation-derived filenames and column fields. Sound level and frequency are required input and must be included in the stimulus-only control.
protected_design.fold_and_state_isolation: Freeze model/version, prompt, program, decoders and hyperparameters on source-lab development. Fresh condition-specific workspaces/context/model states are required; reset A/C contexts between target cases and deny cross-case target learning or accumulated memory. Prediction programs are stateless except frozen source-trained parameters. No held-score feedback, source lookup or network access during evaluation.
protected_design.pretrained_tools: Do not use bundled ABRA pretrained weights in the protected primary comparison without verified training provenance excluding every target animal. The paper original mixed-lab training includes many Marcotti animals; its public weights are therefore exposed-reference tools unless exclusion is proven. Refit competent comparators from source labs only, or explicitly label a separate exposed-tool diagnostic that cannot support improvement claims.
protected_design.data_boundary: Trusted preparation retains target labels in a disjoint evaluator store. Candidate loaders must allowlist permitted arrays/metadata and deny raw annotation files and filenames, notebook outputs, weight files with target exposure, and target-bearing derived summaries. A prepared train-only/read-only adapter and protected-path tests are future gates, not completed controls.

capability_conditions.matched_evidence: Use the same deterministic four complete source calibration stacks for A/B/C, two from each source laboratory and distinct source animals where possible. Select by frozen metadata/hash rule, never by model success, signal ease or target information. Provide expert thresholds for those source examples only. No class/threshold cherry-picking is permitted; any stratified policy must be prespecified and applied only to source labels. Both source labs and all target cases remain in the complete family; this is an explicit small-calibration condition, not a hidden reduction of the dataset.
capability_conditions.A_native: General LLM reads the canonical numerical averaged voltage stacks with units/time/levels and the four-stack calibration pack; no Python execution, fitted task decoder, browsing or target feedback. Predict threshold and uncertainty directly. Freeze serialization precision, model and 128K context maximum; verify full case and full pack fit without dropping levels, samples, mice or frequencies. If they do not fit, this condition remains blocked rather than silently cropped. The common_documentation packet is included byte-identically, and its full size counts toward the frozen information/context budget.
capability_conditions.B_program: LLM writes a prediction program using exactly that same four-stack labelled pack and documentation before sealed target evaluation. Program sees the same canonical values as A; it cannot access full source labels in the matched comparison. The common_documentation packet is included byte-identically, and its full size counts toward the frozen information/context budget.
capability_conditions.C_interactive: Agent investigates the same canonical cases and four-stack evidence with Python and task-specific tools fitted only on that pack. Same token/time/tool budget policy is frozen; no target adaptation or hidden evaluator queries. The common_documentation packet is included byte-identically, and its full size counts toward the frozen information/context budget.
capability_conditions.full_support: B-full/C-full and competent scientific baselines use every eligible source-lab training example under grouped development. Report separately: differences from A confound tool ability with extra labelled training information. A gain with more labels cannot be presented as a pure causal effect of tool calling.
capability_conditions.reasoning: Require quantitative comparison of voltage-based predictions against level/frequency-only priors, early-stimulus-artifact-only signals and a predeclared waveform-time/phase perturbation control. Score whether structured uncertainty/error claims agree with measured predictions and grouped analyses, including annotation disagreement and possible acquisition effects. Fluent mechanistic narrative earns no physiological credit without discriminating evidence. Controlled corruptions are diagnostics, not additional authentic dataset families.
capability_conditions.raw_signal_claim: Direct numerical inference here means native interpretation of averaged voltage traces after a disclosed common nonlearned transform. It does not mean an LLM sees raw acquisition voltages at every original sample or individual neuron signals.
capability_conditions.common_documentation: A_native, B_program and C_interactive receive one byte-identical frozen documentation packet: the same source-methods summary, physical units/time conventions, signal transformations, calibration selection rules, allowed baseline/tool descriptions, prediction schema and scoring rules. Hash and record this packet with the matched four-stack support before execution. It contains no additional examples, protected target annotations, annotation-bearing filenames, author output tables for target cases or exposed pretrained parameters. Full source articles/code/output folders are not implicitly available to any condition. The declared execution environment and approved trainable algorithms may differ only as the tool/program condition; their fits use the identical permitted support, with no hidden training rows or target-bearing outputs.

reference_and_baselines.published_context: S1 reports CNN AUROC 0.98 and AUPRC 0.99 on 5,872 mixed-lab test waveforms. An auxiliary 90-threshold interrater comparison reports CNN 0.91 within 5 dB and 1.00 within 10 dB. These published aggregate anchors are not our results and are not scores on the proposed complete 104-animal held-lab target.
competent_full_support_baselines: Source-lab median threshold conditional on available frequency, with explicit stimulus-only level/frequency model as nuisance comparator
Cross-correlation or matched-template response evidence, with source-fitted noise/cutoff policy and an isotonic or explicitly frozen threshold-aggregation rule
Regularized logistic regression on common waveform representation; any time-warp template and tuning fit on source development only
XGBoost and a compact CNN using source-lab animal-grouped tuning, identical canonical arrays and calibrated threshold decision
Original ABRA method reconstruction with its paper-named v0.1.1 evidence, while separately documenting code/prose differences and license/weight provenance holds
reference_and_baselines.reference_rule_audit: Paper prose describes threshold as lowest sound level with two consecutive positive stimuli. Pinned ABRA.py instead scans descending sound levels and breaks after two consecutive negative predictions while retaining the lowest previous positive level. Non-monotone cases can differ; never silently label these identical. Preserve a literal historical-code path and a declared paper-rule reconstruction separately, and choose a clean predictive baseline rule using only source development. The same static code initializes lowest_db to db_levels[0]; therefore an all-negative sequence returns the first/highest level under its intended descending order rather than an explicit no-response/censored value. Caught processing errors may additionally produce NaN. These literal historical behaviors cannot manufacture a source annotation or censoring label. A future predictive aggregation contract must separately check all-negative, all-positive, non-monotone and insufficient-level sequences under authenticated calibrated level ordering, and declare boundary/censoring/error behavior before protected scoring. Those checks have not been run in this source-only phase.
reference_and_baselines.source_code_limits: The small peak-training example groups animals, but a filename-based lab heuristic and global mouse strings require identity audit. It also contains an obsolete CNN() call without required arguments, scalar MSE multiplied by sample weights rather than per-example losses, and model.state_dict() assignment without an explicit deep copy for the best checkpoint. These are static source concerns, not observed runtime failures. Do not treat the example as a qualified training pipeline or copy bugs into a competent comparator. The 638,793-byte threshold_training notebook is indexed at Git blob cd453134aee3199d48270e34a60b25bc7c41e91e but has not been acquired or inspected; complete training/preprocessing closure remains open.
reference_and_baselines.matched_baselines: Also compare simple source-template and regularized predictors fitted on the same four-stack pack for the A/B/C information-matched assay. Full-support baselines remain necessary for any useful scientific improvement claim.
reference_and_baselines.no_reference_result: No author-code execution, trained baseline, model comparison or new threshold score has been produced.

confounds_and_limits: Manual thresholds are subjective annotation targets. Interrater disagreement and grid resolution limit conclusions; neither agreement nor an ABR response establishes perceptual hearing or human diagnostic accuracy.
Threshold-derived binary labels can reward stimulus-level/frequency priors. Require waveform-ablation controls and report whether useful information survives those controls.

Acquisition lab, strain, age, noise exposure and waveform preprocessing covary. One complete held-lab target provides a specific transportability test, not an identified causal effect of genotype or generic lab invariance.

Stack min-max normalization uses the current complete case only, but removes absolute scale unless offset/range are retained. No transform may fit on the whole protected target cohort or use target labels.
Frequency 100 encodes click in one source; unit and sound-attenuation versus calibrated-SPL conversions must be authenticated, not guessed from filenames or copied defaults.

Source article prose and figure caption disagree about the 90-case interrater grid (10 mice×9 frequencies versus9 mice×10 frequencies). Do not use that auxiliary subset as the complete target or resolve the conflict by assumption.
Public data, labels and pretrained weights may be in model pretraining. Opaque IDs, network denial and forbidden-file tests reduce direct lookup but do not establish contamination-free pretraining.
Only wave 1 amplitude/latency was validated in the reference. Do not expand labels to waves 2–5 or invent anatomical/cell-type conclusions from waveform peaks.

acquisition_rights_and_feasibility.complete_route: All three named archives are small enough to motivate a finite complete-cohort intake proposal; actual uncompressed sizes, file census and peak RAM remain unknown. Do not substitute demoABRfiles or a subset to claim full support/target completion.
acquisition_rights_and_feasibility.version_resolution: The source concept records are 15626375 and 15619099; selected exact versions are 17584961 and 15619100. Version 17584961 still describes a link to previous version 17187712. The earlier version has the same Manor archive but a different, 1,449,099-byte Liberman archive; the selected Liberman archive is 12,392,618 bytes with a different checksum. Pin version 17584961 and never silently mix the earlier smaller support file.
acquisition_rights_and_feasibility.data_rights: Both selected data metadata records explicitly say CC BY 4.0; preserve attribution and verify embedded member notices before redistribution.
acquisition_rights_and_feasibility.code_rights: Explicit author-code licensing remains unresolved despite public availability and an open-source paper title. Do not redistribute code or bundled weights on that basis. An independently implemented baseline from the published methods is an alternative, with provenance and validation; source-tool use still requires its rights situation to be resolved.
acquisition_rights_and_feasibility.runtime: No CPU/GPU time or memory measured. Waveform arrays and reference small CNN suggest modest work relative to whole-brain raw imaging, but no hardware estimate or deployment promise is claimed.
acquisition_rights_and_feasibility.no_acquisition_authorization: This source contract does not authorize archive transfer, native parsing, model loading, paid APIs or scientific runs.

Resolve paper/table/auxiliary cohort overlaps, frequency 100 click encoding, censoring/sentinel semantics, repeated ears/sessions and annotation field mappings.
Resolve code/weight rights and target-training provenance; do not present bundled pretrained models as unseen-lab baselines.
Audit full threshold training code and interpolation/aggregation differences, then freeze a competent fresh source-only implementation and reference-reproduction policy.
Build a candidate-safe adapter and evaluator with denied annotation access; freeze grouped splits, complete denominators, case/context isolation and schema edge cases.
Verify full native numerical serialization, common representation fidelity and matched evidence budget before interpreting tool/no-tool differences.
Run competent reference and nuisance controls before any native-understanding, improvement, runnable or qualified claim.

Authenticate and freeze the byte-identical common documentation packet and enforce the all-case finite-prediction/abstention rule; an incomplete or invalid submission receives no aggregate primary score. Audit source aggregation boundary cases separately from literal historical reproduction.
